ios.desc:
HOW TO USE (FAST)

Create an alarm

Pick your mission + difficulty

When it rings, complete the challenge to dismiss

WAKE-UP TIPS
• If you oversleep often, start with “Shake” or “Reaction” on Hard
• If you snooze by habit, set Snooze to Off and rotate missions daily
• If you wake up but fall back asleep, use a second alarm with a different mission
• Use labels like “WORK”, “GYM”, “EXAM” to stay consistent

MISSIONS ARE BUILT FOR REAL MORNINGS
Every mission is designed to be quick, clear, and impossible to auto-tap through. You’ll use your brain, hands, or movement immediately—math, memory, typing, patterns, reflexes, motion-based tasks, and real-world challenges. That’s why it feels like a real wake-up, not just noise.

REAL-WORLD WAKE-UP CHALLENGES
Some mornings need more than tapping a screen. Alarm Arcade includes physical, real-world challenges that force you to get out of bed:
• Scan a Barcode or QR code to stop the alarm
• Find an object using your camera and confirm it before dismissal

WHO THIS IS FOR
• Heavy sleepers who need a strict alarm clock
• People trying to stop snoozing
• Students who can’t miss classes or exams
• Early risers building a morning routine
• Anyone who wants a gamified alarm that actually works

PRIVACY & SIMPLICITY
Alarm Arcade works offline and does not require an account. Your alarms stay on your device. No social features, no cloud sync—just a clean alarm app with missions.

PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
Want more variety and control? Unlock additional missions, sounds, widgets, and customization options so your wake-up never becomes predictable.

Make waking up non-negotiable. Set the alarm. Beat the mission. Start the day.

ALARM SETTINGS YOU EXPECT
• Label your alarms (Work, Gym, Study, Flight, etc.)
• Repeat by day (Mon–Sun) for weekly schedules
• Snooze options when you want them (or turn snooze off completely)
• Choose a mission and difficulty per alarm (Easy / Hard)
• Pick alarm sounds (with optional vibration / haptics for extra punch)

MISSIONS INCLUDED
Alarm Arcade mixes different wake-up triggers so you can’t build a lazy habit. Rotate them to stay unpredictable:
• Memory Match — finish all pairs
• Mental Math — solve fast problems
• Shake — shake to fill the meter
• Tilt Maze — tilt to reach the target
• Reaction Grid — tap the lit tile quickly
• Simon Says — repeat the sequence
• Typing — type the phrase exactly
• Swipe Pattern — swipe the arrow order
• Pattern Draw — draw the lock pattern
• Hold Timer — hold and rele

show_hn.title: Show HN: Alarm Arcade – an alarm app that only stops after you beat a mini-game

quotes.text:
I built this because I kept turning off alarms half-asleep and going back to sleep.

Instead of snoozing, the alarm only turns off after you complete a short mini-game (memory, math, reaction, tilt).

Would love feedback on whether this actually helps people wake up.
